answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 38529 Country: MY Title: My son's name is Fazil Ahmed Taha Question: My son's name is Fazil Ahmed Taha. I came to know that the name Taha is not recommended. Please clarify whether we can continue with the name or do we need to change it. Answer ID: 38529 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 874/705/B=1433) The name Fazil Ahmed Taha is correct, however it is too long. If you keep only 'Fazil' or 'Fazil Ahmed' then it would be far better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
